item.title: Making Caddy, AWS EC2, CloudWatch, Step Functions, and Lambda Work Together
item.description: I already ran Caddy at home for Home Assistant. This article is the AWS edge version: a t4g.nano EC2 instance, automatic HTTPS, JSON access logs shipped to CloudWatch by a nightly Python script, and a Step Functions workflow that runs two Lambda functions over those logs. The goal was cheap visibility into a personal reverse proxy, not a SaaS dashboard bill.
